items.verification: Network-disabled airplane/instruments/contact, corrupt/interrupted download, quota and active-session version/delete handling.
items.completion_residual: Unknown exterior stays unknown; commercial/Ion/OSM redistribution is never inferred from cacheability.
items.issue_acceptance: Airplane, instruments and physical surfaces work in the declared area with the network disabled. Unknown exterior terrain stays unknown. Interrupted/corrupt download never replaces a valid pack; quota errors preserve saves, and deletion/version update respects the active session.

items.title: Add a genuinely distinct 737 family variant
items.assessment: Only the 737-800 pack exists; 737-700 data/geometry/rights are unqualified.
items.implementation: Select lawful variant references; build dimension/mass/performance profile and matching exterior/contact stations; reuse explicitly common systems.
items.verification: Matched-condition qualified reference cases, silhouette and differentiated handling review.
items.completion_residual: Complete versioned pack integration and hangar acceptance; unsupported envelopes stay unavailable.
items.issue_acceptance: Variant identity affects more than the title and livery; dimensions and reference cases match the chosen evidence packet within declared tolerances. Unsupported operating regions remain labeled. Include side-by-side silhouette and matched-condition handling review.

items.title: Add a light piston trainer with its own flight character
items.assessment: Jet/two-engine UI and flap assumptions prevent a genuinely distinct trainer.
items.implementation: Select one lawful trainer packet; implement single-engine propeller power/RPM and its instruments/configuration; begin warm-engine circuits.
items.verification: Trainer-specific climb/level/stall/circuit cases, RPM-animation/audio and sync/worker parity.
items.completion_residual: Complete convincing manual-flight pack and separate pilot review; richer starts/avionics are explicit follow-ons.
items.issue_acceptance: A reproducible climb, level-flight, stall/recovery and circuit set uses trainer data and instruments, not scaled 737 constants. Propeller animation/audio agrees with RPM. Instructor/pilot review remains a separate acceptance gate; no flight-training certification claim.

items.title: Explore a regional turboprop and short-field route pack
items.assessment: Turboprop propulsion/reference eligibility has not been established.
items.implementation: Produce a bounded propulsion/source feasibility case; choose one supported airplane and airport pair; implement torque/RPM/feather/beta only after qualification.
items.verification: Engine-out/feather drag signs, ground-only beta/reverse and runway eligibility.
items.completion_residual: Deliver exploration findings if infeasible; full pack proceeds only with demonstrated source/playability gates.
items.issue_acceptance: Engine-out asymmetry, feathered drag and ground reverse have bounded tests and explicit evidence status. Route/runway eligibility is validated; beta cannot silently operate in unsupported flight conditions. Ship only after source and playability gates pass.

items.title: Explore a glider energy laboratory
items.assessment: Current jet-oriented contract cannot represent a qualified unpowered glider by simply removing thrust.
items.implementation: Select a lawful glide polar; implement an unpowered profile/airbrake/variometer and one still-air air start; then author bounded lift fields.
items.verification: Independent sink/glide residuals, total-energy variometer assumptions and captured-seed replay.
items.completion_residual: Deliver feasibility boundary honestly; thermals/ridge lift and complete pack need qualified baseline and synthetic-weather labels.
items.issue_acceptance: Still-air sink/glide cases match the chosen polar within published tolerances; variometer total-energy behavior is documented. Lift-field seeds replay consistently. Clearly distinguish educational gameplay fields from real soaring-weather advice.

items.title: Add optional, bounded haptic flight feedback
items.assessment: Input/output availability does not establish real controller haptic support.
items.implementation: Probe one actual supported controller; implement opt-in bounded touchdown/stall pulses with intensity and cancellation.
items.verification: No output on pause/disable/disconnect/reset; rate limit and actual-hardware observation.
items.completion_residual: Publish supported/unsupported browser-device matrix; keep equivalent visual/audio cues.
items.issue_acceptance: No actuator output while paused, muted-for-feedback, disconnected or reset; pulses are rate-limited and cancel on user disable. Visual/audio equivalents remain available. Verify on real hardware and document unsupported paths instead of treating feature detection as proof.

items.title: Make aircraft effects match their emitters and conditions
items.assessment: Contrails use one aircraft emitter, engine 0 and altitude threshold.
items.implementation: Add named per-engine anchors and simulation-time effects; explicitly mark simplified atmosphere eligibility; implement contact-conditioned spray/smoke.
items.verification: Correct-engine shutdown, pause/replay, dry/airborne/no-slip suppression and particle cleanup/budget.
items.completion_residual: Add prop-specific effects for admitted packs; never invent humidity truth.
items.issue_acceptance: Engine shutdown affects the correct trail; paused/replayed effects align with simulation time. Spray/smoke cannot appear airborne or on incompatible dry/no-slip states. Desktop/mobile captures verify emitter placement, density and cleanup without hiding aircraft details or sacrificing frame budgets.

items.title: Add flight-aware photo capture with honest provenance
items.assessment: Composite-scene capture/cross-origin behavior needs proof before a photo workflow.
items.implementation: Probe capture from paused/replay scene; add bounded framing/resolution, optional overlays and local provenance metadata.
items.verification: No blank download/state change, cross-origin fallback, memory cap and live/degraded/replay labels.
items.completion_residual: Finish accessible framing and attribution; video/camera paths remain measured follow-ons.
items.issue_acceptance: Capturing leaves the flight/controls intact and cannot silently claim a degraded screenshot is production scenery. Unsupported capture reports a clear fallback without blank downloads or memory spikes. Asset license/attribution requirements remain accessible; clean images do not erase provenance from the accompanying metadata.

items.title: Add a bounded original-livery workshop
items.assessment: One original texture set is distinct from a user preset/workshop contract.
items.implementation: Add bounded color/registration/stripe editing on one qualified template; preview and save versioned local preset with canonical compatibility.
items.verification: Long text/alpha/colors/size, incompatible UV version, texture disposal and no script/HTML injection.
items.completion_residual: Import logos/textures only with separate bounded file/rights validation; no general editor or marketplace.
items.issue_acceptance: Presets identify the compatible aircraft/template; incompatible UV/model revisions fail visibly. Long registrations, transparency, bad colors and excessive texture size are handled without clipping or GPU overload. Repeated previews dispose old textures; user content cannot execute scripts or inject HTML.

items.title: Investigate VR without committing the main runtime to it
items.assessment: XR support for the dual renderer and actual headset ergonomics is unverified.
items.implementation: Design one target-headset/browser probe and stereo owner contract; measure eye scale, readability, input, motion timing and desktop return.
items.verification: Actual headset evidence and resource/frame budget; desktop nonblank output is insufficient.
items.completion_residual: Deliver feasibility/limits and cockpit-only alternative; full VR renderer/product commitment needs explicit reviewed decision.
items.issue_acceptance: Exit gate requires actual headset evidence of correctly framed stereo, readable instruments, usable input, stable motion timing and successful return to desktop. A nonblank desktop canvas is not VR proof. Report unsupported devices, resource costs and comfort limitations without claiming medical safety.

items.title: Design a single-authority shared-cockpit experiment
items.assessment: Same-origin pop-outs do not establish a networked authority/security/latency design.
items.implementation: Write observer/copilot roles, authoritative host, session/sequence epochs, command limits and disconnect policy; review protocol/threat/latency design.
items.verification: Specify adversarial reorder/duplicate/jitter/unauthorized/ownership cases and reconnect snapshot age/version.
items.completion_residual: Design is the initial deliverable; two-client service/transport probe and deployment remain separately authorized.
items.issue_acceptance: A future probe must survive jitter, reorder, duplicate messages, malicious commands, pilot/copilot conflicts and disconnect without stale control capture or unauthorized actions. Rejoining receives a version-compatible snapshot with age indicators. Capture reproducible latency/authority evidence; never call same-machine message tests multiplayer acceptance.
